text.p: These are the leading stories in the Moroccan press on Saturday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Crown Prince Sidi Mohammed to visit Spain on Monday.
- Colombian President Samper says at end of visit to Morocco that the two countries are examining joint free zone project in Morocco.
- U.N. envoy Baker to visit North Africa in June to meet regional leaders over Western Sahara.
- Morocco ranks third among African countries in terms of foreign direct investment flow.
- Government discusses draft law on civil servants' retirement.
- Moroccan farmers export 461,000 tonnes of citrus fruit in 1997 season to April, against 510,000 tonnes in same period last year.
